decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8361. Series context: trend strength 0.8152 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.158); 7 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 5.168.
